forward-deployed-crm-architect-berlin-104325,GTM Base,Forward-Deployed CRM Architect,Berlin,True,1795359652,"RevOps is changing fast, and so is the way GTM processes get built and maintained inside the CRM. This role puts you on the front edge of it: forward-deployed in our clients' RevOps teams, building and running their GTM systems in a genuinely AI-first environment.

GTMBase is an AI-first GTM engineering and RevOps agency. We help post-PMF B2B companies (€8M to €50M ARR, 5+ reps) whose go-to-market is over-performing their systems. Reps do manually what should be automated, sales and marketing data doesn't connect, and leadership can't trust the reporting.
We combine strategic GTM thinking with hands-on technical build, and we fix the foundation before running campaigns.
Data Foundation: list building and enrichment so reps win with better data (Clay, Apollo, custom scrapers, AI research)
RevOps & CRM: building the right GTM process inside the client's CRM, including architecture, lifecycle, pipelines, routing, and reporting (HubSpot, Salesforce)
Agentic Workflows: building agentic GTM workflows with Anthropic Managed Agents and Hermes, getting the org ready for Agentic GTM
GTM Strategy & Plays: recommending and executing the highest-impact campaigns
We've done this for clients including Groupon, Blinkist, Booksy, and Sendify. We work in small pods, with a Strategist, a CRM Architect, and a GTM Engineer.

We run the company on Claude Code. It's our operating system: client context, playbooks, automations, and delivery all live in it, and AI is the default way we work rather than a bolt-on. You'll work this way too, and get very good at it.

You're the person who turns our GTM strategy into a CRM that actually works. Most clients run their entire revenue motion on HubSpot or Salesforce, and the quality of that system runs through this role: how clean the data is, how well leads route, whether leadership can trust the reporting.

Here, ""Architect"" means architecting inside the CRM: the object model, pipelines, workflows, and automations. The GTM and revenue strategy is set with you in your pod, not by you alone, and you build it with real craft.
You're forward-deployed: you embed with clients' RevOps and sales teams and build inside their live CRM.

You'll build and maintain GTM process and automation inside our clients' CRMs, mostly HubSpot. Working from the direction set in your pod, you turn requirements into a clean, well-built system the sales team can rely on.

One week you're building a client's lead lifecycle and routing. The next you're debugging a broken automation, untangling duplicate deals, or shipping a dashboard a CRO asked for. You move across several client instances at once without dropping threads.

You're a builder with an admin's discipline. You know the object model, not just the UI. You sweat the details others miss, you test before you ship, and you document what you build so the rest of the pod can run it. When something breaks, you find the root cause and fix it properly.
How This Differs From a GTM Engineer
Your pod is you (CRM Architect), a Strategist who sets direction and hands you requirements, and a GTM Engineer. You and the GTM Engineer are both builders, but you own different layers:

You (CRM Architect, Pillar 2): the GTM process inside the CRM. HubSpot/Salesforce architecture, lifecycle, routing, deal logic, automation, reporting, data integrity. You live in HubSpot, Salesforce, Operations Hub, and n8n.
GTM Engineer (Pillar 1): the data layer. Enrichment, scraping, signal detection, list building, custom research agents. They live in Clay, Apify, custom scrapers, and data APIs.

Think of it as the data into the CRM (GTM Engineer) versus the system it lands in and the process the sales team runs on (you). You don't need to be a Clay or Apify expert. You just need a solid working understanding of what a GTM Engineer does, enough to spec what you need, integrate their output cleanly, and know what's possible.

Architect and build in client HubSpot instances: information architecture (objects, associations, lifecycle stages, pipeline structure), workflows, deal logic, lead scoring, routing, properties, and permissions
Build and debug automations across the GTM stack: HubSpot workflows, n8n, APIs, and webhooks. When an automation breaks, you find the root cause rather than just toggling features
Guard data integrity: deduplication, field validation, association hygiene, and import discipline so reporting and forecasting can be trusted

Build the reporting leadership relies on: pipeline coverage and velocity, stage-by-stage conversion, and full-funnel dashboards. You know where HubSpot's platform and paywall limits force a different approach
Design integrations and data flows between HubSpot and the rest of the stack (Clay, Aircall, telephony, billing, enrichment pipelines)
Turn requirements into working builds: take a brief like a 15-minute lead-response SLA and ship the routing system that delivers it
Keep multiple client instances healthy at once, with fast turnaround and nothing falling through the cracks
Work client-facing: you can talk through a data question with a technical lead and walk a frustrated AE through a new flow in the same afternoon
Codify what works into our library of reusable plays and patterns, so every client build sharpens the whole team

Deep HubSpot expertise: hands-on across Sales, Marketing, Service, and Operations Hubs. You know HubSpot well enough to know what is and isn't possible at the platform level, and to choose native functionality over a workaround when it's the right call.
Strong CRM and RevOps fundamentals: lead lifecycle and qualification, routing and assignment, pipeline and deal-stage setup, the data model, and the governance that keeps it clean.
An admin's discipline: precise, reliable, and detail-obsessed. You test before you ship, you keep data clean, and you don't let things fall through the cracks.
A builder's instinct: you build workflows and integrations, debug them when they break, and aren't intimidated by APIs, webhooks, or a tool you haven't used yet.

AI-first, and we mean it literally: AI is your default operating mode, not a novelty. Your first move on a problem is to reach for an agent, a prompt, or a workflow before a manual process. If you're not already using AI tools daily, this isn't the right fit. (If your CRM fundamentals are deep but your GTM-tooling experience like Clay or Claude Code is light, that part is learnable and we'll back you on it. The fundamentals and the AI-first instinct are not.)
Forward-deployed temperament: comfortable building across multiple clients in parallel, client-facing, proactive, and able to move fast without waiting for perfect requirements.
Full-time availability with reliable overlap to CET hours.
Salesforce: admin or build experience, especially HubSpot to Salesforce sync and migrations (relevant to Groupon and enterprise work)

A working understanding of the GTM Engineer's toolkit: Clay, Apify, enrichment providers (ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit), scraping. Enough to collaborate, spec, and integrate. Your pod's GTM Engineer owns the deep builds.
n8n orchestration and custom API integrations
Scripting (Python, SQL, or JavaScript) for data manipulation and custom connectors
German: a good chunk of our client base is DACH
HubSpot certifications: a plus, never a gate. Demonstrated depth matters more.
Real client build work from day one, with no busy work and no hand-holding

Nous accompagnons les plus grands groupes et scale-ups françaises : Decathlon, Doctolib, AXA, ManoMano, Mirakl, Disney, Leboncoin et une centaine d'autres. Nous sommes 200, majoritairement à Paris.Thiga Academy, c'est notre organisme de formation. On y forme les équipes produit (Product Managers, Product Owners, Designers, Product Leaders) et celles qui veulent le devenir : product management, product discovery, leadership produit, et IA appliquée au produit. En inter-entreprise comme en intra, on transmet ce que nos consultants pratiquent chez nos clients tous les jours

L'Academy forme chaque année 2000 professionnels et son offre est solide. Le problème : aujourd'hui, elle ne communique presque pas. Peu de contenu, peu de présence, une notoriété très en dessous de ce que le catalogue mérite.

C'est une page blanche côté growth, et c'est exactement ce qui rend le poste intéressant. On cherche quelqu'un pour construire, mesurer et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition de l'Academy à partir de zéro : quels canaux, quels messages, quel funnel, avec quels résultats. Pas pour décorer le catalogue, pour le remplir.
1. Construire et faire tourner le moteur d'acquisition, avec le Head of Marketing &amp
Structurer le tunnel d'acquisition de bout en bout : quels canaux amènent du trafic, ce qui convertit en lead, ce qui déclenche l'inscription
Tester des canaux et des formats en continu (LinkedIn organique et payant, email, SEO, partenariats, salons) et couper vite ce qui ne marche pas
Créer et itérer les landing pages du catalogue et des sessions, pensées pour convertir dès le premier jet et retravaillées à partir de la donnée
Mettre en place les séquences email dans HubSpot : nurturing, relances, réactivation des contacts dormants, avec un test A/B sur les objets et les CTA
Accompagner le lancement des nouvelles formations avec un plan d'acquisition dédié, pas seulement un plan de com
Créer les supports nécessaires au tunnel avec Figma (catalogue, plaquettes, brochures) en gardant en tête qu'un support existe pour convertir, pas pour exister
Représenter l'Academy sur des salons et événements, avec un objectif de leads qualifiés en sortie, pas juste de présence
Le nerf du poste. Sans mesure, pas de growth, juste du marketing qui se raconte des histoires.

Suivre les KPIs qui comptent à chaque étape du tunnel : trafic, taux de clic, taux de conversion en lead, taux de conversion en inscrit, coût d'acquisition par inscrit, taux de remplissage des sessions
Construire les dashboards HubSpot qui donnent une vision claire de ce qui marche, canal par canal, campagne par campagne
Identifier où le tunnel fuit et proposer les hypothèses à tester pour colmater
Faire remonter les résultats au Head of Marketing &amp
column2: Events pour arbitrer les prochains messages, offres et canaux, avec des chiffres, pas des impressions

column1: 3. Faire vivre la marque et la communauté qui nourrissent le funnel
L'acquisition ne marche pas sans contenu ni preuve sociale. C'est le carburant du tunnel.
Poser la ligne éditoriale et la faire vivre : posts LinkedIn, articles, newsletters, formats courts autour du product et de l'IA
Animer la relation avec les alumni et la communauté d'apprenants : témoignages, cas concrets, un bouche-à-oreille qu'on peut transformer en canal d'acquisition mesurable

L'IA n'est pas une option chez nous, c'est la pierre angulaire de notre façon de travailler, et on attend de toi que tu aies cette fibre. Concrètement, tu t'appuieras sur l'IA à chaque étape : générer et itérer des variantes de copies avec Claude, produire des visuels avec Nano Banana et Figma, des teasers avec HeyGen, ou transformer une transcription Granola en article et en carrousel LinkedIn. C'est ce qui te permet d'avancer vite et de tester dix fois plus d'hypothèses qu'une équipe classique.
La stack que tu vas pratiquer 🧰
Le growth marketing moderne, c'est une combinaison d'intuition testée par la donnée, de vitesse d'exécution et de bons outils au bon moment.
LLM et agents : Claude (Pro et Code), Gemini
Génération visuelle et audio : Nano Banana, Adobe Firefly, ElevenLabs, HeyGen
Marketing ops : HubSpot (CRM, marketing hub, workflows), Luma, Phantom Buster
Prise de notes et capitalisation : Granola, Notion AI
Vibe coding (en bonus, pour les profils qui veulent aller plus loin) : Lovable, Cursor pour bricoler des micro-outils internes
Tu n'as pas besoin de tout maîtriser à l'arrivée. On attend une vraie curiosité et l'envie de pratiquer, pas un CV exhaustif.
Formation : école de commerce ou de communication, en M1 ou M2, idéalement avec une spécialisation marketing, growth ou entrepreneuriat

Pratique IA personnelle prouvée : tu as un side project, un compte ChatGPT ou Claude que tu utilises tous les jours, un workflow Make ou n8n que tu as construit, un agent custom, un blog assisté par LLM, un repo GitHub, ou n'importe quoi qui démontre que l'IA est dans ta vie.
Réflexe growth : tu penses en funnel avant de penser en campagne, tu formules des hypothèses avant de produire, et tester puis mesurer te vient plus naturellement que produire pour produire
Appétence data : Excel ou Google Sheets n'ont pas de secret pour toi, et l'idée de creuser un dashboard pour comprendre pourquoi un taux de conversion a bougé t'intéresse plus qu'elle ne t'ennuie
Fibre communication : tu sais écrire pour être lu, tu as déjà animé une page, un compte ou une communauté
Rigueur opérationnelle et sens du détail : tu sais qu'une séquence email qui commence par « Bonjour {prénom} », ça fait tâche, et qu'un A/B test mal cadré ne prouve rien
Sensibilité business : tu comprends les concepts MQL, CAC, NPS, et tu sais qu'une belle campagne ne vaut rien si elle ne remplit pas les sessions
Au-delà des hard skills, on recherche surtout quelqu’un de curieux, volontaire, débrouillard et qui n’a pas peur de proposer des nouvelles idées !
Stack IA premium : Claude, Gemini, et accès facilité à tous les outils IA quand ils sont pertinents pour ton travail
Encadrement et présence au quotidien de membres de l'équipe marketing pointus sur les sujets growth, événementiel et IA

column2: Projet FLOWATTLe projet FLOWATT, dans le cadre duquel s’inscrit cette étude, vise à déployer et exploiter six hydroliennes dans les forts courants marins du Raz Blanchard, en Normandie.Au-delà de la production d’énergie, FLOWATT a pour objectif d’évaluer le potentiel du Raz Blanchard pour le déploiement de fermes hydroliennes à plus grande échelle. Cette évaluation repose notamment sur une caractérisation précise de la ressource, une estimation fine du productible et une meilleure compréhension des impacts environnementaux. Pour répondre à ces enjeux, le projet combine mesures in situ, modélisation numérique et essais expérimentaux afin de fournir les connaissances nécessaires à la préparation des futurs déploiements commerciaux, tout en contribuant à la réduction des coûts de production et à la limitation des impacts sur l’environnement marin.Dans ce contexte, la caractérisation de l’état de mer constitue un enjeu important, notamment dans une zone soumise à des courants très intenses. La présente étude s’intéresse ainsi aux données de radar HF acquises depuis fin 2017, ainsi qu’à celles qui seront nouvellement enregistrées dans le cadre du projet TidalRace. Le système, de technologie WERA, est réparti sur deux sites distants d’environ 5 km au Cap de la Hague et fonctionne à deux fréquences, 13,5 MHz et 24,5 MHz. Les acquisitions sont réalisées en continu, à raison de quatre mesures par heure, 24 h/24 et 7 j/7, sur une emprise couvrant l’ensemble du Raz Blanchard. Cette couverture temporelle et spatiale offre ainsi une opportunité unique de suivre l’évolution des états de mer dans des conditions hydrodynamiques particulièrement contraintes.L’exploitation de ces données nécessite toutefois d’adapter les méthodes de traitement aux conditions de forts courants. L’objectif des travaux est donc d’améliorer les algorithmes existants et, si nécessaire, d’en développer de nouveaux afin de restituer de manière fiable les spectres d’énergie des vagues en fréquence et en direction, ainsi que les paramètres moyens associés. Une première étape consistera à comprendre les limites des méthodes actuelles, qui ne permettent plus de restituer un état de mer cohérent avec les références disponibles lorsque la vitesse du courant dépasse 1 m/s, comme montré par Lopez et al. (2018). Les méthodes développées seront ensuite évaluées à partir des mesures in situ et des modélisations numériques. Le radar HF constitue ainsi un élément central de ce travail, dont l’amélioration doit permettre de mieux caractériser les états de mer dans les forts courants du Raz Blanchard.Missions / Activités principales&nbsp

column1: product-manager-f-h-lille-79200,Hubvisory,Product Manager - F/H,"Lille, Hauts-de-France, France",False,1795080688,"Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN.Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs produits digitaux et de leurs organisations. Ton rôle est d'allier vision stratégique et excellence opérationnelle pour délivrer de la valeur tangible dans des environnements complexes.Ce que tu fais concrètement :Tu conduis les phases de Discovery de bout en bout. Entretiens utilisateurs, cadrage des besoins, personas et benchmarks : tu identifies les problèmes réels pour construire les solutions qui comptent.Tu pilotes la conception et la delivery. Tu interprètes toi-même les insights, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher. Une vraie maturité data, c'est ce qui distingue les PM junior des PM qui créent de la valeur.Tu mesures l'impact. Tu définis et analyses les KPI et OKR pour t'assurer que le produit sert les objectifs business, tout en animant les rituels agiles pour maintenir une dynamique d'équipe exemplaire.Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.Tu as travaillé sur des briques IA (recommandation, agents, GenAI) ou tu as une appétence réelle pour intégrer l'IA au cycle produit ? On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l'IA partout.👉&nbsp
column2: Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l'IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. Si tu es PO aujourd'hui et que tu veux devenir PM, on te donne les moyens : mentorship, cas complexes, retours structurés. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs qui se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022&nbsp
column3: (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.)Des valeurs fortes : depuis 8 ans Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l’ambition, l’expertise et l’apprentissage.Le package : 41.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu'à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.  👉 Le profil que nous recherchonsTu justifies d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager sur des produits digitaux. column1: ai-product-manager-lille-30774,Hubvisory,AI Product Manager,"Lille, Hauts-de-France, France",False,1795080688,"Le Product Management, c'est notre ADN. L'IA, c'est ce qui est en train de changer le métier.Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs produits digitaux et de leurs organisations. Entretiens utilisateurs, cadrage des besoins, personas et benchmarks : tu identifies les problèmes réels pour construire les solutions qui comptent. Et tu sais reconnaître, parmi ces problèmes, ceux que l'IA résout vraiment de ceux qu'elle complique.Tu qualifies les cas d'usage IA avant de les construire. Faisabilité, valeur, coût, données disponibles, risque d'erreur acceptable : tu instruis le sujet avec rigueur. Tu portes la décision de ne pas faire d'IA quand elle ne se justifie pas : c'est aussi ça, la maturité sur le sujet.Tu embarques l'IA dans le produit, pas à côté. Tu travailles main dans la main avec les data scientists et les AI engineers : définition de ce qu'est un « bon » résultat, seuils de confiance, stratégies de repli quand le modèle se trompe, interfaces qui rendent l'incertitude lisible pour l'utilisateur, boucles de retour pour progresser dans le temps.Tu pilotes des périmètres produit complexes et interdépendants. Règles métier, états et transitions, cohérence entre plusieurs surfaces (interface interne et parcours client en ligne), contrats d'intégration avec les produits adjacents : tu tiens la vue d'ensemble et tu stabilises ce qui doit l'être, dans des écosystèmes où ton produit n'est jamais seul.Tu prends la donnée en main. Tu interprètes toi-même les insights, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher. Une vraie maturité data, c'est ce qui distingue les PM junior des PM qui créent de la valeur, et c'est le socle sans lequel aucun produit IA ne tient.Tu mesures l'impact. Tu définis et analyses les KPI et OKR pour t'assurer que le produit sert les objectifs business, tout en animant les rituels agiles pour maintenir une dynamique d'équipe exemplaire.Tu participes à la vie d'Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d'expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.Bonus : tu as déjà outillé ton propre quotidien de PM avec l'IA : rédaction et structuration de specs, dépouillement d'entretiens utilisateurs, exploration de données, prototypage rapide ? On aime les PM qui testent, qui gardent ce qui marche et qui savent dire ce qui ne marche pas.👉&nbsp

d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !  Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur activité et leurs flux financiers au quotidien.Tu les accompagnes notamment sur les sujets liés :à l’ouverture et à la gestion de leur compte professionnel

column1: mid-market-account-executive-france-saint-etienne-222551,Samsara,Mid-Market Account Executive - France,"Saint-Etienne, France",False,1795020328,"Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €20k to €200k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.
Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.

You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.

You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.&nbsp
Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.
Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.
The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We'll want to see this on your resume.&nbsp
Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.
Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.

A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.

A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.

Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our&nbsp

column1: founders-associate-business-operations-100-remote-weltweit-reichartshausen-241916,Peters und Partner,Founder's Associate / Business Operations (m/w/d) – 100% Remote weltweit,Reichartshausen,True,1795345262,"Remote von überall auf der Welt, direkt an der Seite von zwei Gründern, die schon über 20 Firmen aufgebaut haben.

Wir bauen Firmen um Menschen herum, die eine gute Idee haben und sie selbst vorantreiben wollen. Unsere beiden Gründer sind Venture-Architekten: Sie bringen Kapital, Vertrieb, Administration und die richtigen Leute zusammen, die Gründer der neuen Firmen bringen Idee und Antrieb. So sind schon über 20 Firmen entstanden, von Pet-Tech über E-Commerce und Einkaufsdienstleistungen bis zu Software für Anwälte. Zusammen beschäftigt die Gruppe weltweit eine dreistellige Zahl an Mitarbeitern.

Unser Ziel ist eine Maschine, die aus jeder guten Idee eine erfolgreiche Firma macht, die ohne die beiden läuft. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die diese Maschine mit aufbaut. Von wo aus du das tust, ist uns egal.

Du machst aus unserer Arbeitsweise Prozesse. Vieles steckt heute in den Köpfen der beiden Gründer: wie wir mit Gründern arbeiten, wie wir Firmen aufsetzen, wie Reporting läuft. Du schaust es dir an, schreibst es auf und baust daraus klare Abläufe.
Du baust ein System, über das die Gründer unserer Firmen regelmäßig berichten.
Du prüfst neue Ideen am Markt: Du führst viele Kaltakquise-Telefonate, holst ehrliches Feedback ein und hilfst schnell zu entscheiden, ob aus einer Idee eine Firma wird.
Du managst die Termine der beiden Gründer und buchst Flüge und Reisen.
Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben, die auf Deutsch erledigt werden müssen.
Mit der Zeit wirst du ihre rechte Hand.
Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gutes Englisch, weil ein Teil unseres Teams in Indien sitzt
Du denkst in Strukturen und machst gern aus Chaos klare Abläufe
Mit Fremden zu telefonieren fällt dir leicht, für dich ist es der schnellste Weg zu Antworten
Du arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst nicht für jeden Schritt eine Anleitung
Du gehst sicher mit digitalen Werkzeugen und KI-Tools um
Du bist zuverlässig und diskret, denn du bekommst Einblick in viele Firmen
Erfahrung aus einem Startup, einer Beratung oder als Assistenz der Geschäftsführung hilft, ist aber keine Bedingung. Wichtiger als der Lebenslauf sind uns Lernbereitschaft und Motivation.
100 % remote, egal wo auf der Welt du lebst
Festanstellung in Voll- oder Teilzeit, mit Wohnsitz außerhalb Deutschlands ist auch Freelance möglich
Du lernst extrem schnell: wie Firmen entstehen, finanziert und aufgebaut werden, in über 20 Firmen aus ganz unterschiedlichen Branchen und Phasen
Du arbeitest direkt mit den beiden Gründern zusammen
Du baust etwas Eigenes: Die Prozesse und Systeme, die du schaffst, tragen am Ende die ganze Maschine

column1: senior-fullstack-engineer-berlin-80839,Upvest,Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d),Berlin,False,1795275618,"At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.About the role:Team's mission Upvest's core product is an API: the execution layer that moves securities for our clients. Upfront extends into the layer above it. It's Upvest's operational service panel for enterprise clients, giving their operations, support and compliance staff the ability to handle first-line requests themselves: looking into an end-user's account, checking what happened to an order, answering the question in front of them. Today their options are to ask Upvest support or to build a service panel of their own, which most of them won't do.Our mission is to prove that financial institution customers can replace their fragmented operations with Upfront. That case isn't settled yet, and this team is the one making it. Our users do this work all day, so a clumsy interface is how a task turns back into a ticket for us. Our clients are already asking what AI can do for their operations teams. Agentic operations, exposed over MCP, is where we think this goes. What it should look like in Upfront is still open, and we'd like the person in this role to help define it.Upfront is part of the Clients Tribe at Upvest. Together with the Public API and Tooling Apps teams we enable Upvest’s business to scale efficiently, accelerate our client’s time-to-market and embed intelligence and automation into client processes.Your missionYou’ll focus on building what actually creates value for our clients. While our OKRs set the destination, we expect you to help map the route. We prioritize impact and shipping speed over a perfectly groomed backlog. Because you're on a client-facing team, the quality of your output directly impacts client trust – especially since we are handling their customers' money.In our domain, the bar is high: anything touching client funds must be correct and auditable, or it's an incident. We will give you the client context, access, and autonomy to figure out what needs building, rather than just handing you a rigid spec. We also expect you to challenge our internal processes if they are slowing down your efficiency or shipping speed.What you’ll do:Take operational problems from concept to production, working across our React/TypeScript frontend and Go backend services.Own modern interface security. Upfront is where external users act on real end-user data, so you will tackle per-client isolated environments, least-privilege access, and Auth0 integrations in a regulated space.Expand the operational surface across Upvest's internal domains and develop a deep understanding of how our core systems piece together.Help define how software delivery works in an AI-enabled company by pushing AI tooling to its limits to maximize quality and speed while staying compliant.Build agentic operations as we move toward exposing Upfront over MCP. Every action requires a strict audit trail, so you will solve real design problems around what an agent can do autonomously versus what requires human intervention.Work in weekly cycles with bi-weekly retrospectives to prioritize high-quality, high-frequency shipping. What you bring:A strong product engineering mindset where you care about the ""why"" just as much as the ""how"" and proactively bring ideas to the table.Solid backend experience in Go, Java, or Kotlin (we build in Go but will give you time to ramp up).Practical experience building modern client-facing interfaces using React and TypeScript.Experience building products that require per-customer configuration without devolving into a custom fork per client.Deep knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices.A strong focus on quality, extensibility, and automated testing.True end-to-end ownership across containers, CI/CD pipelines, and relational data modeling.A working understanding of event-driven architectures.A pragmatic approach to engineering and the ability to make smart tradeoffs under constraints.Real-world experience using AI tools to drive software engineering workflows, not only writing code snippets .The ability to navigate undefined problems and align other teams without needing formal authority. It’s great if you have:Experience with Investment products or the Fintech domain, in general.Experience building operational or back-office tooling for business users.Experience with identity platforms such as Auth0, or with multi-tenant isolation.Experience with operating services in a decoupled, event-driven system, leveraging modern observability tooling (e.g. monitoring and tracing). How we Upvest in you:Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.Our Values:Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.Healthcare systems are failing us
column2: clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.The roleWe’re looking for an experienced seller with an entrepreneurial mindset to help build Heidi’s next stage of growth across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.There’s already momentum: clinicians using the product, customers recommending us and healthcare organisations coming to us with interest. You’ll build on that foundation by closing strategically important deals, creating new pipeline and turning individual adoption into broader organisational relationships.This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a broad commercial remit. You’ll personally own opportunities from first conversation to signed agreement, while helping us develop partnerships, strengthen our market presence and figure out where to focus next.You might spend one day building a business case with a hospital group, the next prospecting into a priority account, and another working with a potential partner or helping shape a local event. You’ll bring the judgement to choose what matters and the follow-through to make it happen. What you’ll do Own strategically important deals: Lead opportunities with practice groups, MVZs, clinics and hospital groups from discovery and demos through business case development, negotiation and close. Build relationships with clinical champions, operational leaders and executive decision-makers.Build your own pipeline: Identify the accounts and segments worth pursuing, develop a clear approach and do the outreach yourself. Use targeted prospecting, introductions, local networks and creative approaches to open conversations.Convert the demand coming to us: Respond quickly to inbound interest and use product adoption signals to uncover larger opportunities. Recognise when an enthusiastic clinician could become the starting point for a practice-wide or group-wide rollout.Help buyers reach a decision: Understand their workflows, priorities and buying process. Bring the right stakeholders together, coordinate internal support on technical, security and procurement questions, and give pilots clear success criteria and a route to rollout.Help build the wider market: Develop relationships with software providers, professional associations, clinical advocates and other potential partners. Work with colleagues on conferences, webinars, customer stories and commercial initiatives that create trust and qualified demand.Improve how we sell: Turn what you learn into better messaging, account prioritisation and sales processes. Use AI and commercial tools to improve your effectiveness, keep the CRM accurate and maintain a realistic view of your pipeline and forecast.Bring the market back into Heidi: Share clear evidence about why customers buy, what slows adoption and where product improvements or localisation could unlock growth. Work closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success and the wider DACH team. What you'll needA proven record of selling and closing: You’ve personally owned a revenue target and can explain the deals you originated, how you won them and the results you delivered. Experience in B2B software or a similarly complex commercial environment is particularly relevant.Strong sales craft: You know how to run discovery, build a compelling business case, develop champions and navigate opportunities involving several stakeholders. You can earn credibility with both a clinician and a CFO.The ability to create opportunities: You’ve built pipeline through your own efforts and know how to turn an account list or a promising introduction into meaningful commercial progress.A generalist’s range and judgement: You enjoy work beyond the immediate deal: testing a channel, developing a partnership, organising a customer session or solving a problem that is holding growth back. You can balance that breadth with delivering your number.Independence and pace: You create structure when the playbook is still being written, make sensible decisions with incomplete information and follow through without being chased.Fluent German and strong English: You can lead nuanced commercial conversations in German and work effectively with a global team.Curiosity about healthcare and AI: You’ll learn the product properly, take clinicians’ concerns seriously and use AI thoughtfully in your own work. You’re open to feedback and willing to change your approach when the evidence changes.Particularly useful experienceBeing an early AE or helping grow a new territory at a scaling company.Selling into DACH healthcare or another complex, regulated market.Building partnerships or turning individual product usage into larger organisational deals.How we show upBuild for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it. Why Heidi?You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.True A-players progress extremely fast here. column1: remote-regional-sales-manager-dach-426636,Everfield,"Regional Sales Manager, DACH (m/w/d)",Germany - Remote,False,1795210815,"Regional Sales Manager, DACH (m/w/d)Regional Role · Remote, based in the DACH region · Reports to: Sales DirectorAbout EverfieldEverfield acquires and builds vertical SaaS businesses across Europe. Our portfolio spans more than 40 companies serving niche markets where software is mission-critical. We take a long-term ownership approach: we buy, invest, and build. We don't flip. Seven companies are in DACH, and we expect continuous growth in portfolio size and performance across all regions.We are building a small, high-impact HQ revenue team responsible for lifting the commercial capability of our portfolio companies: setting standards, identifying risk, and accelerating performance. The role reports to Everfield's Sales Director, who owns consistency of the revenue system across all regions, and works day to day with the region's General Director and the CEOs of its Business Units.The OpportunityThe Regional Sales Manager (RSM) is a cluster-level revenue operator responsible for improving sales execution and accelerating organic revenue growth across a group of portfolio companies. The role partners directly with CEOs and Business Unit leaders to strengthen pipeline discipline, improve forecast accuracy, and raise commercial maturity across the region.This is not purely an advisory role. Alongside the regional remit, the RSM is expected to take direct sales management responsibility inside Business Units where that is the fastest route to growth, giving smaller commercial teams access to experienced sales leadership they would not otherwise have. As the region scales, the ambition is that one person can hold the sales management role on behalf of several Business Units at once, applying a standard across all of them.Success is reflected in improved revenue predictability, stronger pipeline discipline, and sustained bookings growth across Business Units.How the Role Operates• Two levels, one standard. The regional remit is constant: diagnostics, pipeline discipline, forecast integrity, and commercial governance across every Business Unit in the cluster. Beyond it, the role flexes. In some Business Units you will coach and support an existing sales manager. In others you will hold the sales management role yourself.• Direct team leadership where it is needed. Where you act as sales manager, you own the team, the pipeline, the forecast, and the number, in the same way a local sales manager would, and you report into that Business Unit's CEO for delivery while remaining accountable to Everfield for how the work is done.• You are not a seller. You do not carry a personal quota and you are not measured on deals you close yourself. You are measured on what the teams you lead and support deliver.• Reporting.
